data.exact_reserve_text: During 2022 the Syndicate released $85.9m of technical reserves in respect of prior years (2021: $105.2m), arising predominantly from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions (2021: predominantly from the Treaty, Marine and Energy divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on prior year losses during 2022.

named_events.loss_description: During 2022, the Syndicate has experienced catastrophe losses from the Russian invasion of Ukraine, and from natural catastrophes notably Hurricane Ian and flood losses in Australia and South Africa.

data.standardized_narrative: During 2022, Syndicate 1084 experienced a gross release of $85.9 million in technical reserves related to prior years. This favourable claims development primarily arose from the Political Risk & Violence, Marine and Property divisions.

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 36 is distorted by the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) of Syndicate 2088 into Syndicate 1084 on 1st January 2022, making it unreliable for calculating prior year development. The '2012 and prior' column in the triangle is an aggregate and cannot be used for diagonal comparison.
